findings.message: Binding bind-refresh-preview collides with a browser-reserved shortcut.
findings.recommendation: Move the shortcut behind an editor-local chord or remove the browser-reserved binding.

findings.message: Binding bind-refresh-preview does not require editor focus before execution.
findings.recommendation: Check active focus target before executing any collaborative editor shortcut.

findings.message: Binding bind-refresh-preview mutates content without mode-specific scoping.
findings.recommendation: Require explicit Markdown, LaTeX, WYSIWYG, or notebook mode scoping for formatting commands.

findings.message: Binding bind-go-comments can hijack workspace navigation outside the editor.
findings.recommendation: Scope the binding to the active editor surface so workspace navigation is not hijacked.

findings.message: Binding bind-go-comments does not require editor focus before execution.
findings.recommendation: Check active focus target before executing any collaborative editor shortcut.

findings.message: Binding bind-format-block conflicts with accessibility navigation.
findings.recommendation: Remap shortcuts that conflict with screen-reader or OS accessibility navigation.

findings.message: Binding bind-format-block mutates content without mode-specific scoping.
findings.recommendation: Require explicit Markdown, LaTeX, WYSIWYG, or notebook mode scoping for formatting commands.

findings.message: Scenario locked-final-figure can mutate a locked section through a shortcut.
findings.recommendation: Block mutation shortcuts inside locked/final-review sections and offer comment-only actions.

findings.message: Scenario locked-final-figure bypasses the expected permission denial path.
findings.recommendation: Run shortcut commands through the same permission gate as toolbar and menu actions.

findings.message: Scenario locked-final-figure mutates shared state without an audit event.
findings.recommendation: Generate a visible audit event before a shortcut mutates shared document state.

findings.message: Scenario notebook-markdown-focus can execute notebook code from a non-notebook surface.
findings.recommendation: Separate notebook execution bindings from manuscript editing and require notebook focus.

findings.message: Scenario notebook-markdown-focus mutates shared state without an audit event.
findings.recommendation: Generate a visible audit event before a shortcut mutates shared document state.

findings.message: Scenario anonymous-reviewer-suggestion can reveal an anonymous reviewer through shortcut side effects.
findings.recommendation: Prevent shortcut-triggered labels, mentions, or presence pings from exposing anonymous reviewers.

findings.message: Scenario anonymous-reviewer-suggestion mutates shared state without an audit event.
findings.recommendation: Generate a visible audit event before a shortcut mutates shared document state.

findings.message: Scenario notebook-formatting-collision routes a manuscript formatting shortcut inside a notebook cell.
findings.recommendation: Separate notebook execution bindings from manuscript editing and require notebook focus.
